how bad

tyler still riding that little bmx up and down the block?
you see that osprey IG post i tagged you in last night

Tell him to document everything from day one. Every doctor visit, every form, every phone call with dates. Mine took eight months and I had stuff written down. Guys who don't track it get steamrolled.

Tell my granddaughter Mimi is bringing her those little garden gloves I found at the Boca Target. The pink ones with the bees on them. She kept stealing yours last Sunday and the dirt was up to her elbows. Love you, Mom
ha she'll lose her mind. we put in the marigolds yesterday after I grabbed her from school, she's been asking when the tomato seedlings come in

gone. she crashes around 4 instead. it's actually fine, gives us the early afternoon to mess around in the yard before Tyler's off the bus
Hey, finally caught a breather between grading and the kids. How's the back holding up? Mom mentioned you were on your feet all Tuesday morning again.
Holding up. The McNab crew put me on orientation duty for a new helper this week, mid-twenties kid named Marcus. Spent the morning walking him through the game cart and the bingo cage.
Look at you. That actually sounds like a really good fit for you, Brian. You're patient with the ones who don't know anything yet.

yeah march should snap back to the 48 range if nothing weird hits

agree. leave the roth at 11k for now, just keep it steady. HSA pull still goes on the 15th

smart. i muted that whole side of facebook months ago. if i'm worked up about something i'll call you or sit with megan, not type into a comment box at midnight

Okay sweetheart. So glad you went back on it last year, you've been so much more like yourself. Love you, Mom
Love you too. See you Sunday.

yep, mac and cheese, she's coloring. Tyler reading log is done too
I got her. Tyler's drop too. I'm on the 9-1 handyman slot at the Hartman place, gonna be home by then anyway.
Ok. And don't forget you said October test date. I want that filing fee paperwork done before May or it's gonna slip to fall and then we're in hurricane season for the launch.
You're the best. Nine years in and Alvarez still books me back-to-back on Mondays 😩
you've earned the right to push back lol. take your full hour
I know. Field guide showed up yesterday, I'll bang out chapter 7 tonight after they're down.

Storm rolled in at 5, didn't go out. Just kind of dragging since lunch.
Yeah I figured. Same thing happened last Tuesday when you slept through. Try to get the mat in at least?
Did the planks and bridges already. Sand was the part I needed.
game on at my place sat. bringing the brisket
want me to grab you a bottle of that bulleit since youre coming over

lmao look at you. fine more brisket for me 😂

yeah usaa is a closed door for us, didn't tick that box back when

right, her husband did. so you and Megan still stuck on State Farm for the renewal?
for now. shopping it before may but not that lane, doesn't open for me or megan either

some hotel off university by the old coral square mall 😂 half those guys still live within 5 miles of where we grew up

venmo from the tile lady, rest cash

i know. that's why i don't put it on anymore. radio in the truck, paper with coffee, and i talk to you about the rest
you okay? you've been pacing the kitchen for an hour
